November 2026 excluded (166 sales so far). Windows set before any model was run.

locked.why: Best development median error among models whose inputs a King parcel layer carries (the WA statewide layer: tax-year-2026 land + building value only): regression on the neighborhood median and that value 8.0% (3818 sales) vs value x sales ratio 8.05%. Even if it passes, the page cannot run it today: its King parcel service is the county zoning layer (PIN and zoning only).
